$comment: Role -> agent mapping for the heterogeneous harness. bin/harness reads this and shells out to `paseo run`. Edit values here; every harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Paseo agents) resolves roles through this file. Valid providers/models: `paseo ls`-able via mcp list_providers/list_models. thinking = provider thinking option id.

plan.notes: Writes implementation plans. Read-only. Output goes to plans/<slug>.md.

plan-alt.notes: Alternate planner. Use for a second opinion or when Anthropic quota is exhausted.

orchestrate.notes: Drives the loop in ORCHESTRATION.md: splits the plan, spawns executors, reviews their diffs, iterates. Alternates: claude/claude-opus-4-8[1m] (huge-context reviews), cursor/claude-opus-5.

exec.notes: Implements one plan task in an isolated worktree. Cheap and fast; the reviewer catches its mistakes.

review.notes: Read-only diff review against the plan task. Same brain as the orchestrator so verdicts are consistent.

investigate.notes: Codebase Q&A: pstack how/why/recall/blast-radius style work. Default unconfirmed by owner - swap for codex/gpt-5.6-terra (medium) if Sonnet answers feel thin.
